desc: Derive level function: level(x) = floor(log4(x)) + 1 for x >= 1; equivalently (x.bit_length() + 1) // 2. Verified: 1-3 -> 1, 4-15 -> 2, 16-63 -> 3.
Establish per-query formula: answer = max(ceil(S/2), level(r)) where S = sum of levels in [l, r]; validated against all three provided examples.
Implement helper `prefix(n)` returning sum of levels for x in [1, n] by iterating k with bucket bounds [4^k, 4^(k+1)-1], adding (k+1) * count; stop when 4^k > n. Use integer arithmetic only.
Implement `minOperations`: for each [l, r], S = prefix(r) - prefix(l-1), ans = max((S+1)//2, level(r)); accumulate and return total. Include `from typing import List`.

Test: examples [[1,2],[2,4]] -> 3, [[2,6]] -> 4; brute-force (greedy simulation) cross-check for all small ranges l < r <= ~40 to confirm the max(ceil(S/2), M) formula; sanity-check [1, 10^9] and performance with 1e5 queries.
